mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SEARCH_HISTORY ( USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, CONTENT_TYPE_ID, SPOT_NAME, ADDRESS, L_DONG_REGN_CD, L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD, LC_LS_SYSTM1, LC_LS_SYSTM2, LC_LS_SYSTM3, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, THUMBNAIL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{contentId}, #{contentTypeId}, #{spotName}, #{address}, #{lDongRegnCd}, #{lDongSignguCd}, #{lclsSystm1}, #{lclsSystm2}, #{lclsSystm3}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{thumbnail}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID AS historyId, CONTENT_ID AS contentId, CONTENT_TYPE_ID AS contentTypeId, SPOT_NAME AS spotName, ADDRESS AS address, THUMBNAIL AS thumbnail, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM SEARCH_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
